senses.sense_definition: To make an excessively high offer to pay or accept a price.

examples.text: The company decided not to <w>overbid</w> for the contract because the profit margins were too thin.

target_lang_translations.zh: 公司决定不对该合同<w>出价过高</w>，因为利润空间太小了。

examples.text: He realized he had <w>overbid</w> on the house after seeing the much lower offers from other buyers.

target_lang_translations.zh: 看到其他买家报出的低得多的价格后，他意识到自己对这栋房子<w>出价过高</w>了。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 出价过高，指为了获得某物而报出超出其价值或承受能力的过高价格。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指报价超过了合理范围或自身预算。

senses.sense_definition: To offer a higher price than someone else.

examples.text: A rival firm managed to <w>overbid</w> us at the last minute during the auction.

target_lang_translations.zh: 在拍卖的最后一刻，一家竞争对手公司成功地<w>出价高于</w>了我们。

examples.text: She was determined to <w>overbid</w> her competitors to secure the rare antique painting.

target_lang_translations.zh: 她决心要<w>出价高于</w>竞争对手，以拍下那幅珍贵的古董画。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 出价高于竞争对手，从而在竞标中胜出。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指通过报出更高价格击败竞争对手。
指在拍卖或竞标中报出比他人更高的价格。

senses.sense_definition: To announce a goal in a game that is higher than what is actually achieved.

examples.text: The team lost the round because they chose to <w>overbid</w> their hand.

target_lang_translations.zh: 团队输掉了这一轮，因为他们<w>叫牌过高</w>了。

examples.text: It is easy to <w>overbid</w> when you are feeling too confident about your cards.

target_lang_translations.zh: 当你对自己的牌过于自信时，很容易<w>叫牌过高</w>。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 在纸牌等游戏中，预估的目标高于实际能够达到的水平。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 特指桥牌等游戏中叫牌超过了实际牌力。

senses.sense_definition: The past tense and past participle of <w>overbide</w>.

examples.text: The knight had <w>overbid</w> his welcome by staying far too long at the castle.

target_lang_translations.zh: 骑士在城堡里待得太久，以至于<w>逗留过久</w>，招人厌烦。

examples.text: He <w>overbid</w> his time in the city and missed his scheduled departure.

target_lang_translations.zh: 他在城里<w>逗留过久</w>，错过了预定的出发时间。

traits.comment: This sense refers to the archaic verb overbide.

target_lang_definitions.zh: 古语动词 overbide 的过去式或过去分词，意为过度停留或超出限度。

senses.sense_definition: An excessively high offer to pay or accept a price.

examples.text: The project failed because of an <w>overbid</w> that made the costs unsustainable.

target_lang_translations.zh: 项目失败了，因为一个<w>过高报价</w>导致成本无法维持。

examples.text: Investors were cautious about the <w>overbid</w> on the property.

target_lang_translations.zh: 投资者对该房产的<w>过高报价</w>持谨慎态度。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 过高的报价，指超出合理范围的竞标价格。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指竞标中报出的不切实际的高价。

senses.sense_definition: An announcement of a goal in a game that exceeds the goal actually achieved.

examples.text: The final score was disappointing due to an <w>overbid</w> in the first round.

target_lang_translations.zh: 由于第一轮的<w>叫牌过高</w>，最终得分令人失望。

examples.text: His <w>overbid</w> cost the team the entire match.

target_lang_translations.zh: 他的<w>叫牌过高</w>导致团队输掉了整场比赛。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 在游戏中，预估目标高于实际达成目标的叫牌行为。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指游戏中因预估过高而导致的叫牌失误。
